summary: BGM Group Ltd. filed a 6-K pertaining to an Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders scheduled for July 9, 2026. The meeting will consider a share capital reduction and reorganization proposal, reducing par value of each issued ordinary and preferred share from $0.00833335 to $0.0001, with the credit transferred to a distributable reserve. Authorized but unissued shares will be subdivided. The EGM notice and proxy card are attached. This filing describes a proposed corporate action rather than a definitive special situation. As a non-US filing, it corresponds to a shareholder meeting proxy or 8-K Item 5.07.
